section.heading: 7.2. Integration Using Tables of Integrals
A Table of Integrals
section.paragraph: We have studied several techniques for finding an antiderivative of a function. However, useful as they are, these techniques are not always applicable. There are numerous other methods for finding an antiderivative of a function. Extensive lists of integration formulas have been compiled based on these methods.

A small sample of the integration formulas that can be found in many mathematical handbooks is given in the following table of integrals. The formulas are grouped according to the basic form of the integrand. Note that it may be necessary to modify the integrand of the integral to be evaluated in order to use one of these formulas.

row.cell: 1. $${\int\frac{udu}{a + bu}} = \frac{1}{b^{2}}\left( {a + bu - a\ln\left| {a + bu} \right|} \right) + C$$ 2. $${\int\frac{u^{2}du}{a + bu}} = \frac{1}{2b^{3}}{\lbrack{\left( {a + bu} \right)^{2} - 4a\left( {a + bu} \right) + 2a^{2}\ln\left| {a + bu} \right|}\rbrack} + C$$ 3. $${\int{\frac{udu}{\left( {a + bu} \right)^{2}} = \frac{1}{b^{2}}\left( {\frac{a}{a + bu} + \ln\left| {a + bu} \right|} \right)}} + C$$ 4. $${\int{u\sqrt{a + bu}du}} = \frac{2}{15b^{2}}\left( {3bu - 2a} \right)\left( {a + bu} \right)^{3 \slash 2} + C$$ 5. $$\int\frac{udu}{\sqrt{a + bu}} = \frac{2}{3b^{2}}\left( {bu - 2a} \right)\sqrt{a + bu} + C$$ 6. $${{\int{\frac{\mathit{du}}{u\sqrt{a + bu}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{a}}\ln\left| \frac{\sqrt{a + bu} - \sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{a + bu} + \sqrt{a}} \right|}} + C} \left( {{if}a > 0} \right)$$

7. $${\int\sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}}}du = \frac{u}{2}\sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}} + \frac{a^{2}}{2}\ln\left| {u + \sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}}} \right| + C$$ 8. $${\int{u^{2}\sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}}du = \frac{u}{8}\left( {a^{2} + 2u^{2}} \right)\sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}} - \frac{a^{4}}{8}\ln\left| {u + \sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}}} \right|}} + C$$ 9. $${\int{\frac{\mathit{du}}{\sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}}} = \ln\left| {u + \sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}}} \right|}} + C$$ 10. $${\int\frac{\mathit{du}}{u\sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}}}} = - \frac{1}{a}\ln\left| \frac{\sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}} + a}{u} \right| + C$$ 11. $${\int\frac{\mathit{du}}{u^{2}\sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}}}} = - \frac{\sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}}}{a^{2}u} + C$$ 12. $$\int{\frac{\mathit{du}}{\left( {a^{2} + u^{2}} \right)^{3 \slash 2}} = \frac{u}{a^{2}\sqrt{a^{2} + u^{2}}} + C}$$

19. $${\int\frac{\sqrt{a^{2} - u^{2}}}{u}}du = \sqrt{a^{2} - u^{2}} - a\ln\left| \frac{a + \sqrt{a^{2} - u^{2}}}{u} \right| + C$$ 20. $${\int\frac{\mathit{du}}{u\sqrt{a^{2} - u^{2}}}} = - \frac{1}{a}\ln\left| \frac{a + \sqrt{a^{2} - u^{2}}}{u} \right| + C$$ 21. $${\int\frac{\mathit{du}}{u^{2}\sqrt{a^{2} - u^{2}}}} = - \frac{\sqrt{a^{2} - u^{2}}}{a^{2}u} + C$$ 22. $${\int\frac{\mathit{du}}{\left( {a^{2} - u^{2}} \right)^{3 \slash 2}}} = \frac{u}{a^{2}\sqrt{a^{2} - u^{2}}} + C$$

23. $$\int{ue^{\mathit{au}}du = \frac{1}{a^{2}}\left( {au - 1} \right)e^{\mathit{au}} + C}$$ 24. $$\int{u^{n}e^{\mathit{au}}du = \frac{1}{a}u^{n}e^{\mathit{au}} - \frac{n}{a}{\int{u^{n - 1}e^{\mathit{au}}du}}}$$ 25. $$\int{\frac{\mathit{du}}{1 + be^{\mathit{au}}} = u - \frac{1}{a}\ln\left( {1 + be^{\mathit{au}}} \right) + C}$$ 26. $${\int{\ln udu}} = u\ln u - u + C$$ 27. $${{\int{u^{n}\ln udu}} = \frac{u^{n + 1}}{\left( {n + 1} \right)^{2}}{\lbrack\left( {n + 1} \right)\ln u - 1\rbrack} + C} \left( {n \neq - 1} \right)$$ 28. $$\int{\frac{\mathit{du}}{u\ln u} = \ln\left| {\ln u} \right| + C}$$ 29. $$\int{\left( {\ln u} \right)^{n}du = u\left( {\ln u} \right)^{n} - n{\int{\left( {\ln u} \right)^{n - 1}du}}}$$

section.heading: Using a Table of Integrals
section.paragraph: We now consider several examples that illustrate how the table of integrals can be used to evaluate an integral.

example.heading: Example 1
example.paragraph: Use the table of integrals to find $$\int{\frac{2x}{\sqrt{3 + x}}dx}$$ .
example.heading: Solution
example.paragraph: Since $$\sqrt{3 + x}$$ is of the form $$\sqrt{a + bu}$$ , with $$a = 3$$ , $$b = 1$$ , and $$u = x$$ , we use Formula (5),

$$\begin{array}{l} {{2{\int{\frac{x}{\sqrt{3 + x}}dx}}}{= 2\left\lbrack {\frac{2}{3(1)}\left( {x - 6} \right)\sqrt{3 + x}} \right\rbrack + C}} \\ {\phantom{2{\int{\frac{x}{\sqrt{3 + x}}dx}}}{= \frac{4}{3}\left( {x - 6} \right)\sqrt{3 + x} + C}} \end{array}$$
